## Bower Security Operations and Pipeline Health

Operational overview of Bower collectors, delivery latency, replay accounting, selected security events, and Privacy & Secret Protection Engine findings in `BowerSecurity_CL`.

All security event counts use the `BowerSecurityEvents` parser so at-least-once delivery replays are collapsed by `(CollectorId, EventId)`.

parameters.name: CollectorId
parameters.label: Collector
parameters.query:
BowerSecurity_CL
| where isnotempty(CollectorId)
| distinct CollectorId
| order by CollectorId asc

content.query:
BowerSecurityEvents
| where ('*' in ({CollectorId}) or CollectorId in ({CollectorId}))
| summarize
    DistinctEvents = count(),
    TotalRows = sum(BowerCopies),
    ReplayedEvents = countif(BowerCopies > 1),
    ExtraRows = sum(BowerCopies - 1),
    HighSeverityEvents = countif(EventSeverity in~ ("High", "Critical")),
    SensitiveDataAlerts = countif(EventType == "sensitive_data_detected")
content.title: Security signal and replay summary

content.query:
BowerSecurity_CL
| where EventType == "collector_health"
| where ('*' in ({CollectorId}) or CollectorId in ({CollectorId}))
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Attributes) by CollectorId
| project
    CollectorId,
    LastRecord = TimeGenerated,
    Status = tostring(Attributes.status),
    Problems = tostring(Attributes.problems),
    Delivery = tostring(Attributes.delivery.status),
    Undelivered = toint(Attributes.queue.undelivered),
    OldestAgeSeconds = toint(Attributes.queue.oldestUndeliveredAgeSeconds),
    QueuePagesPercent = todouble(Attributes.storage.queuePagesUsedPercent),
    VolumeState = tostring(Attributes.storage.volumeState),
    VolumeFreePercent = todouble(Attributes.storage.volumeFreePercent),
    DeadLettered = toint(Attributes.queue.deadLettered)
| order by CollectorId asc
content.title: Collector overview (newest health record per collector)

content.query:
BowerSecurity_CL
| where EventType == "collector_health"
| where ('*' in ({CollectorId}) or CollectorId in ({CollectorId}))
| extend
    DelaySeconds = datetime_diff('second', ingestion_time(), TimeGenerated),
    Undelivered = toint(Attributes.queue.undelivered)
| summarize MaxDelaySeconds = max(DelaySeconds), MaxUndelivered = max(Undelivered) by CollectorId, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
content.title: Delivery delay and queue backlog over time

content.query:
BowerSecurityEvents
| where ('*' in ({CollectorId}) or CollectorId in ({CollectorId}))
| summarize Events = count() by Source = strcat(ApplicationName, "/", ApplicationEnvironment), bin(BowerEventTime, 1h)
content.title: Distinct security events per source per hour

content.query:
BowerSecurityEvents
| where ('*' in ({CollectorId}) or CollectorId in ({CollectorId}))
| summarize Events = count() by EventCategory, EventType, EventSeverity
| order by Events desc
content.title: Security events by category, type and severity

content.query:
BowerSecurityEvents
| where ('*' in ({CollectorId}) or CollectorId in ({CollectorId}))
| summarize
    Events = count(),
    Rows = sum(BowerCopies),
    ReplayedEvents = countif(BowerCopies > 1),
    ExtraRows = sum(BowerCopies - 1),
    MaxCopies = max(BowerCopies),
    RewrittenTimes = countif(BowerTimeRewritten)
    by CollectorId
| order by ExtraRows desc, CollectorId asc
content.title: Replay accounting by collector

content.query:
BowerSecurityEvents
| where EventType == "sensitive_data_detected"
| where ('*' in ({CollectorId}) or CollectorId in ({CollectorId}))
| summarize Findings = count(), LastSeen = max(BowerEventTime) by ApplicationName, ApplicationEnvironment, EventSeverity, CollectorId
| order by Findings desc
content.title: Privacy and Secret Protection Engine alerts (metadata only)

content.query:
SentinelHealth
| where SentinelResourceType == "Analytics Rule" and SentinelResourceName startswith "Bower"
| summarize TotalRuns = count(), Failures = countif(Status != "Success"), LastRun = max(TimeGenerated) by SentinelResourceName
| order by Failures desc, SentinelResourceName asc
content.title: Bower analytics rule health (requires SentinelHealth diagnostics)
